tasks.description: Load the dirty dishes into the dishwasher
steps: place plates in the bottom rack
place glasses and cups in the top rack
tasks.final_state: the dishwasher is closed and the counter has no dirty dishes

tasks.description: Unload clean dishes from the dishwasher and put them away
steps: take plates out of the rack
take glasses out of the rack
tasks.final_state: the dishwasher is empty and closed

steps: pick up a cloth or sponge
tasks.final_state: the counter is clean and clear

steps: scrub a dish with a sponge
place the dish on the drying rack
tasks.final_state: the sink is empty and the clean dishes are on the drying rack

tasks.description: Set the table for a meal
steps: place a plate on the table
place a fork to the left of the plate
place a knife to the right of the plate
place a glass above the knife
tasks.final_state: each place on the table has a plate, cutlery, a glass and a napkin

tasks.description: Make a cup of coffee with a machine
steps: insert a coffee capsule or ground coffee
place a cup under the spout
tasks.final_state: a cup filled with coffee is on the counter

steps: pick up a garment from the pile
place the folded garment on the stack
tasks.final_state: all clothes are folded and stacked

steps: take a wet garment from the basket
hang the garment on the line or rack
tasks.final_state: the basket is empty and the garments hang on the line

steps: spread the duvet over the bed
place the pillows at the head of the bed
tasks.final_state: the bed is made with the duvet flat and pillows in place

tasks.description: Vacuum the floor of a room
tasks.final_state: the floor is clean and the vacuum cleaner is stored

steps: pour water into a plant pot

tasks.description: Assemble a part at a workbench
steps: tighten the screws with a tool
place the assembled part in the output bin
tasks.final_state: the assembled part is in the output bin

tasks.description: Pack items into a cardboard box

steps: place the item in the matching bin
tasks.final_state: all items are in their bins and the table is empty
